items.summary: OU got back in the win column on Saturday, beating Mississippi State in Starkville. The Sooners delivered a gritty performance, overcoming several injuries and the flu on the road. What are the biggest takeaways from the game? Here are 10 things SoonerScoop's George Stoia thinks he knows after Oklahoma's 23-15 win over Mississippi State.

items.title: Isaiah Sategna continues to deliver for OU: "Just get him the ball"

But even though opponents are hyper-aware of his game-breaking abilities, Sategna simply continues to burn them anyway.

items.title: Sooners standing by Sandell despite struggles Saturday
items.summary: Tate Sandell brought a Groza Award to Norman in 2025. He memorably hit a walk-off kick to beat No. 1 Texas in the Red River Shootout just two weeks ago. But thus far in 2026, his accuracy has suffered. And his struggles hit a low point Saturday in Starkville.

items.title: OU overcomes the flu, multiple injuries in gritty win over Mississippi State
items.summary: STARKVILLE, Miss. -- For OU, the hour-long bus ride on Saturday morning from its Tupelo hotel to Davis Wade Stadium in Starkville, was anything but normal. Heck, the entire week was anyting but normal for the Sooners, which battled the flu and several injuries.

items.title: Michael Fasusi, finally healthy, gave OU a shot in the arm Saturday
